shots.intent: 用晨杏圆盘与一片立起巾体的干净剪影，在详情页首屏赢下一眼点击。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline band for 「{selling_point_1}」 with subtitle 「{callout_1}」 and one short apricot-stone rule beneath, plus two outline-ring icon-label pairs 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 down the left margin

shots.intent: 用四枚同规格顾虑卡承接照护现场的日常烦心事，把信息压成一屏可读。
shots.textZone: one short worry label per card reading 「{callout_4}」 at 14pt, letter-spaced eyebrow and dot pager above the grid, headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in the apricot band; every claim carried only by placeholders

shots.intent: 以原料棉铃、巾体纤维与一滴被纤维收走的水同框，代替任何口头品质承诺。
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_5}」 at 13pt in the upper-left shadow zone and one outline-ring caption 「{callout_6}」 at 12pt in the lower-right, nothing else

shots.intent: 同机位同光双格正铺对照，让买家自己看出巾幅铺开区间的差别。
shots.textZone: one short label beneath each panel reading 「{callout_7}」 left and 「{callout_8}」 right at 13pt, headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in the top band; no badges, no figures

shots.intent: 用可看见的分层圆盘讲清水的处理逻辑，以机制代替口头承诺。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_4}」 in the upper band with one subtitle line, one short outline-ring chip label 「{callout_9}」 at the left of each disc, droplet row caption 「{callout_10}」; no numerals rendered anywhere

shots.intent: 把湿巾放进真实照护动线里，让目标人群自我代入而不出现任何面孔。
shots.textZone: small caption strip near the lower-left corner reading 「{callout_11}」 at 12pt, one letter-spaced eyebrow above it

shots.intent: 一屏铺开三类日常擦拭情境，让买家自行对号入座并提高连带。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_5}」 and one subtitle in the top band, one apricot-stone header chip 「{callout_12}」 above each card and one short footer line 「{callout_13}」 inside each card footer

shots.intent: 两包同框展示可选配色与组合，把选择焦虑收在同一屏里。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_6}」 in the upper band, one short variant label 「{callout_14}」 beneath each pack at 14pt, one combo line 「{callout_15}」 in the lower band; colours taken only from the reference

shots.intent: 用正铺标注与留白参数表消除规格疑问，把全部数字交回占位符。
shots.textZone: card title 「{callout_16}」 at 20pt with four short parameter rows reading 「{callout_17}」 at 13pt; dimension lines labelled 「{callout_18}」; all values are placeholders, no digits rendered

shots.intent: 以收口主张与一枚按钮结束详情页，把浏览收进加购决策。
shots.textZone: lower plum band carries one short CTA pill reading 「{callout_19}」 at 18pt in milk-white type plus a supporting line 「{callout_20}」 at 12pt; no QR code, no membership wording, no price
